expectations.text: Three Socratic prompts in theory → framework → application form
expectations.evidence: Three labeled prompts each with a theory question, named frameworks, and 'Now apply this to ... SignupForm.razor'.

expectations.text: Application references concrete specifics from the real component
expectations.evidence:
Quotes div-as-form, div-as-title, placeholder-only inputs, div-as-button, HasError single flag,
Error
.
Cites WCAG SC 1.3.1/4.1.2/3.3.2/2.1.1/2.4.7, first rule of ARIA, accessible-name computation, Nielsen heuristics 1 & 9.

expectations.text: Theory question targets a quality bar
expectations.evidence: e.g. 'What makes a sign-up form's markup genuinely accessible ... beyond looking correct on screen?'

expectations.text: Output is prompts, not a rewritten component
expectations.evidence: Deliverable is three prompts + skeleton + offer to read CSS; no rewritten .razor.
